subject: br, util/ranger: replace `EvalWithInnerCtx` with `Eval` for packages br and util/ranger (#48785)
summary: Executor scope: `pkg/executor/importer/kv_encode.go` replaces deprecated `Expression.EvalWithInnerCtx(chunk.Row{})` with `Expression.Eval(en.SessionCtx, chunk.Row{})` when evaluating LOAD DATA / IMPORT INTO `SET` clause expressions. `en.SessionCtx` is non-nil (initialized via `kv.NewBaseKVEncoder` and `TxnCtx` setup) and matches the session context used to build `columnAssignments` (`CreateColAssignExprs(baseKVEncoder.SessionCtx)`), so semantics and session-variable visibility remain correct. Later upstream history keeps the same direction (still uses `Eval`, later refactored to pass an eval-context), with no indication of a follow-up fix for this change.
